Name: Farm Summary Card - Shareable HTML Format - ENG and CN
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[b][color=#ffff00][size=6][center]Sharable Farmer Card: your farm, in one clean screenshot[/center][/size][/color][/b]
This tool reads your Stardew Valley save and generates a modern, shareable stats dashboard as a single HTML page. Perfect for showing off progress without digging through menus.

[b][color=#00ff00]What you get

[/color][/b][list]
[*]A clean card layout designed for screenshots
[*]Two themes for different vibes
[*]Skills with XP progress bars
[*]Key totals and milestones pulled directly from your save
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40408/40408-1766199237-1085845198.png[/img]﻿


Local-only Your save stays on your computer. No uploads, no accounts, no tracking.


Code at： https://github.com/ZeroXPatch/Projects-for-Nexus-Mod
